verdict.rationale: Statsig ships a first-party MCP server that lets users talk to their Statsig projects in natural language from ChatGPT, Claude, Codex and Cursor. The documented scope is asking questions, exploring experiments and accessing data. There is no evidence that natural-language commands can perform write actions such as creating or toggling gates, and no native in-console natural-language assistant is documented. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language write/control actions (creating, editing, rolling out gates/experiments), a native in-product natural-language interface, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: With this setup, you can ask questions, explore experiments, and access your Statsig data using AI.
Talk to your Statsig projects from within ChatGPT.
Admins can configure Claude's connection to Statsig centrally instead of asking each member to authenticate.
